abort.already_configured: A JFL Alarm listener is already configured on that port.

error.port_in_use: Another service is already listening on that port.

data_description.host: Leave `0.0.0.0` to listen on every network interface. A specific address is only needed on a machine with several networks.
data_description.port: The panel connects to this port. It must be reachable from the panel's network.

user.description: JFL panels dial out to Home Assistant, so this integration listens and waits. Choose the TCP port to listen on; it must match the reporting destination programmed into the panel. Everything else is detected from the panel itself.

abort.already_configured: That panel has already been added.

data.code_arm_required: Also ask for the code when arming

data_description.code: Leave empty for no code. This is a Home Assistant code, not a panel user code — it is never sent to the panel.
data_description.code_arm_required: Disarming always asks for the code once one is set. Turn this off if you would rather arm without typing it.
data_description.read_only: While read-only mode is on, the integration observes the panel and never sends it a command.

reconfigure.description: Settings for panel {serial}. The serial number identifies the panel and cannot be changed.

data.code_arm_required: Also ask for the code when arming

data_description.code: Leave empty for no code. This is a Home Assistant code, not a panel user code — it is never sent to the panel. It stops a tablet on the wall from disarming the house with one tap.
data_description.code_arm_required: Disarming always asks for the code once one is set. Turn this off if you would rather arm without typing it.
data_description.read_only: While read-only mode is on, the integration observes the panel and never sends it a command. Status is still requested, because the panel only reports its state when asked.
data_description.serial: The ten-character serial the panel reports.

user.description: Panels that report in are added automatically. Add one by hand only if it is not powered up yet.

not_permitted.message: Panel {serial} does not allow this operation from a monitoring connection. Check the panel's programming at address {address}.

panel_not_connected.message: Panel {serial} is not connected, so the command was not sent.

read_only.message: Panel {serial} is in read-only mode, so nothing was sent. Turn read-only mode off in the panel's settings to allow arming and disarming.
